deep.reconstruction: There is no mathematics on this page. It is a library request or loan slip, not a working manuscript. Reading of the ink text: 'Krönig. Fortschritte der Physik, dargestellt von der physikalischen Gesellschaft zu Berlin. Jahrgang VIII (1852). Berlin 1855.' The underlined first word is the name of the volume's editor, August Krönig (1822–1879), who edited the Berlin 'Fortschritte der Physik' reports in the 1850s. It is not 'König'. Bottom right: signature 'B. Riemann' with '(Physikal.)', apparently stating the purpose of the loan or the institutional affiliation (physics). Pencil annotations: 'Krönig' repeated, apparently a librarian's shelving or catalogue note, and a large sweeping S-shaped pencil stroke across the slip. That stroke is presumably a cancellation mark showing the loan was discharged or returned. Red and pink ink: 'Jun. 13 59', a date, presumably 13 June 1859; the '13' is overwritten in darker red. Grey pencil '52' at top right is the archival folio number. Historical context (my inference, not on the page): June 1859 falls shortly before Riemann's appointment as ordinary professor at Göttingen (July 1859). It also precedes the composition of his gas-dynamics paper 'Über die Fortpflanzung ebener Luftwellen von endlicher Schwingungsweite' (presented November 1859). The 1852 volume of the Fortschritte, with its reports on acoustics, heat and related topics, would fit background reading for that work, but this is speculative. The slip only documents that Riemann borrowed this physics review volume.
